2609.31291.title: Softmax Reparameterization for Output-Head Quantization
2609.31291.paper_summary: Large vocabularies make output heads a substantial inference cost in small language models. We propose softmax reparameterization, a post-training method that selects a functionally equivalent output head before quantization. The method subtracts a scalar multiple of the vocabulary-row mean from every output row and selects the coefficient by validation KL separately for RTN, activation-weighted MSE, and full-Hessian GPTQ. This one-dimensional search includes the original head and fixed mean-centering, preserves the full-precision softmax distribution, and leaves the trained decoder unchanged; a rank-one correction handles nonlinear logit paths such as soft-capping. Across seven heads, W4 gains concentrate where baseline quantization substantially distorts predictions: on Phi-4-mini, AW-MSE KL falls from 0.936 to 0.256. The gains survive stronger GPTQ calibration and remain complementary to exact per-channel scaling and affine quantization. Across four heads and three W4 quantizers, frozen WikiText-selected coefficients also transfer to C4 and OpenWebMath, outperforming mean-centering in all 18 comparisons where the frozen coefficient differs from $1$ and matching it in the remaining six. At W2, used as a compression stress test, benefits broaden across nearly the full model--quantizer matrix. Matched residual analysis shows that improved fidelity can accompany greater logit reconstruction error while reducing the residual's Fisher-weighted cost. For shift-compatible heads, reparameterization adds no inference operation and preserves packed W4 execution: with the decoder held in BF16, quantizing the Phi output head reduces batch-one generation latency by 10.8% relative to the BF16-head baseline.
2609.31291.paper_summary_zh: 大型詞彙量使得小型語言模型中的輸出頭在推理時產生相當大的成本。我們提出了softmax重新參數化，這是一種在量化之前選擇功能等效輸出頭的後訓練方法。該方法從每個輸出行中減去詞彙行均值的標量倍數，並根據RTN、激活加權MSE和全Hessian GPTQ的驗證KL分別選擇係數。這一維度的搜索包括原始頭和固定的均值中心化，保留了全精度softmax分佈，並且不改變訓練好的解碼器；一個秩為一的修正處理了非線性logit路徑，例如soft-capping。在七個頭中，W4的增益集中在基準量化顯著扭曲預測的地方：在Phi-4-mini上，AW-MSE KL從0.936降至0.256。這些增益在更強的GPTQ校準下仍然存在，並且與精確的每通道縮放和仿射量化互補。在四個頭和三個W4量化器中，凍結的WikiText選擇係數也轉移到C4和OpenWebMath，在所有18次比較中超越均值中心化，當凍結係數不同於$1$時，在剩下的六次中則與之匹配。在W2中，作為壓縮壓力測試，效益幾乎擴展到整個模型-量化器矩陣。匹配的殘差分析顯示，改進的保真度可以伴隨著更大的logit重建誤差，同時降低殘差的Fisher加權成本。對於兼容移位的頭，重新參數化不增加推理操作，並保留了打包的W4執行：在解碼器保持在BF16的情況下，對Phi輸出頭的量化使得第一批生成的延遲相對於BF16頭基準降低了10.8%。
